OS official grid structure identifies one <tile name>.asc grid layer per tile package.
OS Terrain50 grid is a 10km tile with 200x200 50m pixels.
OS supplies per-tile metadata and GML alongside the ASC grid.
Canonical extractor appends every matching ASC/TXT member to found[tile] without requiring exactly one grid.
Directory discovery also appends every matching grid path for a tile without a uniqueness check.
_sample_tiles iterates all paths and concatenates all values, so duplicate copies can double-weight a tile.
Duplicated grid values can alter q1/median/q3 weighting even when the duplicate bytes are identical.
Two non-identical same-tile grids are not explicitly rejected before sampling.
Record raw matching grid-member count for every required 10km tile.
Group candidate ASC members by SHA256 before any deduplication.
Byte-identical duplicates may collapse to one sampling grid only if every source receipt is retained.

Selected sampling grid must match the exact expected tile identifier and official .asc identity.
Exactly one normalized sampling grid per required tile may enter _sample_tiles.
Persist all outer/nested archive member paths and SHAs even when identical duplicates collapse.
Bind selected ASC SHA to 200x200/50m/tile-origin fingerprint before sampling.
